newsitem.title: USA: NYH spot gasoline eases, diffs mixed late in day.
newsitem.headline: NYH spot gasoline eases, diffs mixed late in day.

text.p: U.S. spot gasoline prices eased moderately by late Thursday, with lower NYMEX futures more than offsetting firmer differentials on Gulf Coast "M3" conventional unleaded, traders said.
Diffs on front ninth cycle Gulf "M3" firmed 0.25 cent, players said, to about 3.75 cents below the April print.
But activity was thin as some traders cleared their positions in preparation for attending the National Petroleum Refiners Association convention next week in San Antonio.
Volume was even thinner on New York Harbor conventional unleaded, players said, with afternoon bids hard to find.
"It was very well offered but difficult to attract buyers," one would-be New York seller said, with offers for "M4" winter-grade easing 0.25 cent to about 3.50 cents below the screen.

Heating oil diffs eased a bit in both centers, traders said, with New York material offered at about even with the screen and prompt Gulf at 2.0 cents under. But absolute prices were stable as NYMEX values inched higher on cold weather in the Northeast.
Gulf low sulfur diesel diffs showed the biggest differential move among the distillates, slipping about a half cent to about 0.25 cent over the print amid a plethora of sellers, traders said.
